> If anyone knows of any work towards more open-ended fitness functions, I'd love to read it.

There is research in open-ended learning, see "Why Greatness Cannot Be Planned" by Kenneth O. Stanley. So the idea is to replace fitness with novelty search which provides more stepping stones towards the goal.

Covered calls

For me the movie  articulated the transience of human existence and the receding beauty of the natural world as time passes--a fading that grows within us as we age.

c.st: God created the real numbers
c.x:
To a mathematician saying god created the integers is the same thing as saying god created the rationals: there’s a bijection between the rationals and integers.

I’m not convinced that we could have our current universe without irrationals - wouldn’t things like electromagnetism and gravity work differently if forced to be quantized between rationals? Saying ‘meh it would be close enough’ might be correct but wouldn’t be enough to convince me a priori.
